title: Cross-functional acceptance calendar & compliance preflight for routing-engine V2 PRD
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Coordinate a firm calendar and preflight checklist across Engineering, Design, and Legal to unblock final PRD sign-off for Routing Engine V2. Goal: close ambiguity in API compatibility, dataflow/PII boundaries, UX acceptance criteria, and performance SLOs before scoping freeze. This ticket sets a deterministic path (owners, deadlines, required artifacts) and captures review outcomes and follow-ups so the release team can proceed with Dedicated and Private deployment gating.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering provides a single consolidated SLO matrix for latency/throughput with test harness links
Design publishes annotated UX acceptance checklist with edge cases and accessibility notes
Legal confirms dataflow diagram + short memo on PII/non-PII classification and any contractual constraints
All three teams sign the PRD doc (Confluence) using the sign-off table and any open action items are assigned with due-dates
No outstanding blocker-level comments in the PRD review thread older than 48 hours before release scoping freeze
